don’t even know where to start this place is so incredibly bad
Around three years ago I went to the GP (eventually) and said I needed a referral to a Hemochromatosis specialist (moved to the area and needed to be transferred)
I was told there wasn’t one in Northampton
I also asked for a coil replacement (been in for its five years) also told yeah we don’t do that here and no idea where you would get that done. One year later I provided them with name of a consultant for the HH and asked for the referral. I was told it would be done and wasn’t
Fast forward to now. After feeling terrible I paid for my own blood tests indicating that my iron profile was wrong and I needed an urgent referral. I also experienced a worrying symptom for something else
I got sent a link for a phone call in two weeks. I complained by email using NICE guidelines and got a phone call that day. I got the referral but goodness knows who to and when I said I now want to discuss this other symptom (that could identify cancer and required immediate investigation) the doctor (who told me five times he was a locum) refused saying he could  only  discuss one topic in the allocated 10 minutes!!
I escalated again, copying in ICB and Pals and amazingly got a physical visit where the urgent referral then took place
I spoke to the gynae unit today and they told me that I should have been referred for a replacement three years ago and it’s a simple process the GP knows how to do!

That’s the big stuff, aside from that it’s been a round of reading letters wrong and sending wrong prescriptions, not sending prescriptions, waiting ridiculous times for even a phone call.
